findings.claim: max() on the pending list raises ValueError when there is no PENDING task in the queue, and this exception is not caught or documented.
findings.failure_scenario: Call dequeue(queue) where queue is empty, or contains only tasks with state RUNNING/COMPLETED/CANCELLED/FAILED (e.g. all tasks currently RUNNING) -> pending == [] -> max(pending, key=...) raises 'ValueError: max() arg is an empty sequence' instead of returning None or raising a domain-specific error.
